descriptions.zh: 对[from.GetName]的轨道扫描后我们的系统瞬间被有益的固件更新包轰炸。我们的船现在运行得比以前平稳得多，但这些数据包的性质表明这个星球曾经属于§H[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]§!。
descriptions.en: An orbital scan of [from.GetName] instantly bombarded our systems with beneficial firmware updates. Our vessel now runs more smoothly than before, but the very nature of these data packets suggest this world once belonged to the §H[origin_unplugged_assimilator_empire.GetName]§!.

descriptions.zh: 我们对[from.GetName]的扫描发现该行星上有大量被抛弃的科技产物，而且是近期遗弃于此。整个星球上仍跃动着电脉冲信号，许多遥感探测器因此难以维持稳定的朝向。这片错综复杂的电磁场迷雾中究竟潜藏着什么不为人知的秘密呢？
descriptions.en: Our initial scans of [from.GetName] suggest this planet is rich in discarded technology, but was abandoned only recently. Electrical impulses still dance across that world while many of our remote probes struggle to keep coherent headings. What mysteries lie within the haze of these intricate electromagnetic fields?

descriptions.zh: 对[root.GetName]初步扫描的结果令人费解。它的大气中包含着痕量来自原始冶金技术的污染物，然而表面扫描却发现了复杂的太空级合金。航拍图像上可以看到[from.owner.GetPreFTLLower]社会的聚落，然而堡垒建筑上却装有面对空激光武器。我们建议对这一不一致性进行进一步研究。
descriptions.en: Results from our initial scans of [root.GetName] do not make proper sense. Its atmosphere bears traces of pollution from primitive metalworking, yet our surface scans found evidence of sophisticated, space-worthy alloys. Aerial imagery shows settlements from a [from.owner.GetPreFTLLower] society, yet their fortified buildings are fitted with surface-to-air laser weaponry. We recommend studying these inconsistencies further.

descriptions.zh: 在一个别无值得一提的星系中，有一座复杂的监测站孤零零地矗立着，它早已荒废到难以修复的程度。它在监测什么，它又为什么会聚焦在[fromfrom.GetName]中这样一个狭小的区域呢？
descriptions.en: Alone in a system devoid of other noteworthy phenomena is a sophisticated monitoring station, long since decommissioned and put beyond repair. What was it monitoring, and why was it focused on such a tightly enclosed region of [fromfrom.GetName]?
